Box 83720, Boise, ID 83702 │ Web: sos.idaho.gov MEDIA ADVISORY For Immediate Release July 23, 2026 Information Contact: Joe Parris Public Information Officer (208) 332-2860 Media Advisory: Initiative Arguments Deadline Set for July 31 The Idaho Secretary of State’s office is continuing to accept arguments for and against the Reproductive Freedom and Privacy Act, which will appear on the November 3, 2026 General Election ballot as Proposition One. Select arguments supporting and opposing the proposition will be included alongside the ballot language in the official voter pamphlet, which will be mailed to every Idaho household before the November General Election. Arguments must be submitted to the Secretary of State's Office no later than 11:59 p.m. Mountain Time on Friday, July 31, 2026. Submissions may be made through the online form at: https://forms.sos.idaho.gov/pro-con/. Additional information about Idaho's initiative process is available at https://voteidaho.gov/initiatives-amendments/. The 2026 Idaho Voter Pamphlet will also include information on the constitutional amendments and the advisory question approved by the Idaho Legislature for the November ballot through HJR 4, HJR 6, and House Bill 932. ---###---
